entities.name: Ethersworn
entities.description: Group of human, vedalken and sphinx mages on Esper dedicated to infusing all life with etherium (the Noble Work).

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Alaran shard where the Ethersworn live.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: Sphinx whose teachings the Ethersworn follow.

entities.name: Noble Work
entities.description: The Ethersworn quest to fuse Esper's life with etherium.

entities.name: Ignoble Flesh
entities.description: Splinter group taking the philosophy to an extreme, replacing the body with etherium.

entities.name: aether-liches
entities.description: Those who have replaced their entire body with etherium.

relations.quote: The Ignoble Flesh is the term for a splinter group who takes this philosophy to an extreme.
